sam-sre: Postmortem follow-up: we have 3 high-priority remediation items that change SLO wording and dashboards. Need owners, acceptance criteria, and dates.
tia-product: I can own SLA wording + customer comms. Will propose: keep shared-hosted p95=320ms, add Dedicated p95=275ms, and add a new throughput SLO for batch endpoints. Draft in 4 business days.
owen-oncall: I will own runbook + failover test. Plan: add auto-fallback to quantized variant when p99 > 1s for 3m; document manual throttle steps. Prototype in staging in 5 days.
nina-platform: I'll own dashboards and alerts. Need exact queries for p95/p99 by model and per-tenant QPS; will add an error-budget burn gauge and a recurrence heatmap.
cesar-telemetry: I'll add incident markers and a regression job that replays top 10 tenant prompts weekly. Dashboard query sketch:
``nselect model_variant, tenant_id, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99, count() as qps from requests where env='prod' and time > now() - 1h group by model_variant, tenant_id``n
sam-sre: Infra-bot please create a ticket for the sprint with due date = 14 days. Include acceptance criteria: SLA PR merged, runbook tested in staging, grafana panels live, telemetry job running.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-4601 created: "SLO remediation sprint - dashboards/runbook/telemetry" assigned to sam-sre, due 2026-04-22. https://tickets.example/RWD-4601
tia-product: Acceptance criteria: SLA PR + product signoff + comms plan + FAQ snippet.
owen-oncall: Runbook acceptance: documented steps, staging failover test pass, pager validated.
nina-platform: Dashboard acceptance: live panels in grafana, alert firing tests in staging, link added to oncall home.
cesar-telemetry: I'll attach regression job logs and an alert history sample to the ticket.
sam-sre: Recurring pattern note: this is the 4th embedding-burst related spike in 6 months. Long-term action: per-tenant rate limit or dedicated pool. Added to backlog.
tia-product: Adding backlog item and tagging product/solutions. We'll surface Dedicated option in next QBR.
owen-oncall: For quick mitigation I'll add a proxy throttle flag infra can flip during high-burn.
nina-platform: Timeline recap: SLA draft 4 days, runbook prototype 5 days, dashboards merged 7 days, full remediation 14 days.
sam-sre: Scheduling a 15-min sync in 48h to check progress. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
